ruleDefinitions.name: Usage of Renamed Sysinternals Tools - RegistrySet
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects non-sysinternals tools setting the "accepteula" key which normally is set on sysinternals tool execution

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\PsExec.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ProcDump.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Handle.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\LiveKd.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Process\\ Explorer.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\PsLoglist.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\PsPasswd.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Active\\ Directory\\ Explorer.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\EulaAccepted$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\PsExec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PsExec64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procdump\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procdump64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\handle\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\handle64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\livekd64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\procexp64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psloglist\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\psloglist64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pspasswd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pspasswd64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ADExplorer\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ADExplorer64\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (process_path = "None")
